name: Branching Batch-Tree Class
definition: Fix integers $b,n\ge1$ and put $A=\{0,1\}^b$. The coordinate domain is $X_{b,n}=\{(v,j):v\in\bigcup_{t=0}^{n-1}A^t,\ 1\le j\le b\}$; the empty word is included in $A^0$. For each word $w=(a_1,\ldots,a_n)\in A^n$, define $h_w:X_{b,n}\to\{0,1\}$ by $h_w(v,j)=(a_{t+1})_j$ if $v=(a_1,\ldots,a_t)$ is a prefix of $w$, and $h_w(v,j)=0$ otherwise. Set $\mathcal T_{b,n}=\{h_w:w\in A^n\}$. Thus a concept follows one path through a complete $2^b$-ary tree, reports its outgoing $b$-bit vector at each visited node, and is zero at every off-path node.
comments: The construction width $b$ is distinct from a parameter's query block size $k$. For separation witnesses fix $b$ and $k$ before sending the height $n$ to infinity. The domain and each class are finite. No published origin is claimed for this catalogue construction.
